text:
maya: heads up — noticing increased tail latency on /v1/generate for seq 512-1024. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 320ms over the last hour. profiler hints at kernel fallback + KV cache miss amplification when batch_size > 8.

anil: typo — can you paste the profiler snippet and batch-size hist? curious if it's queue wait or slow kernel.

maya: pasting condensed logs: 
```
route=/v1/generate seq=768 window=10m p50=95ms p95=320ms p99=720ms
kernel_choice: primary=fast-attn opt=fp16 fallback=generic-attn count_fallbacks=142
kv_cache_hit_rate=0.74 -> when batch_size>8 hit_rate drops to 0.62
batch_wait_ms: median=4, p95=82, p99=210
```
noted that kernel fallback correlates with long queue_waits.

liam: batch size histogram from the sampler (1h): 
```
1: 18%
2-4: 42%
5-8: 22%
9-16: 12%
>16: 6%
mean_batch=4.6 median=3
```
This workload has a fat tail of larger batches that push KV cache thrash.

sophie: possible levers: reduce max_batch_wait_ms from 12->6 to cut queue tail, OR add a kernel-selector rule: if seq>512 prefer fp16-attn-only and cap batch at 12 for that route. Also recommend adding token-level latency breakdown on per-route KPI dashboard (decode vs kernel vs io).

anil: quick repro command — run profiler on route with controlled load: 
```
loadgen --route=/v1/generate --seq=768 --qps=60 --clients=50 --duration=5m --record=profiling.out
```
then run: `scripts/parse_profile profiling.out --breakdown token,kernel,io`

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rolling canary to 10% capacity in us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T16:30Z.

maya: implemented temporary selector tweak: if seq>=512 and batch_size_est>12 prefer fast-attn fp16 path and set soft_batch_cap=12. Canary running now at 10%. Initial canary numbers: p95 down to 180ms, kv_hit_rate up to 0.70, fallback_count -63% vs baseline. Need 30m to validate.

liam: will add a continuous-batching metric panel: per-route batch_size histogram + queue_wait heatmap + kernel_fallback rate. put a simple alert: kernel_fallback_rate > 5% for 5m -> paging.

sophie: also add token-level decode vs kernel vs io stacked bars to route KPIs. helps catch if we misattribute.

anil: sounds good. If canary holds, plan to roll to 50% and then full. thanks team :thumbsup:
